owner_direction.decision_5: Draft and review B1 v5 before locking it. Make accuracy with examples present the primary gate, compare against matched compute, and include the valid-code guessing control.
owner_direction.decision_6: Pin the unseen Qwen checkpoint before downloading. Name the host, storage path, and exact revision. Reserve the model for confirmation.
owner_direction.reading_applied: Accuracy with examples present is the primary gate: the adapter runs with the table in the prompt, against the base model with the same prompt and against same-prompt baselines of equal or greater compute. Prompt removal is kept as a separate reported result. (As restated in the owner's status summary of 2026-11-18.)

claim: A support table can be compiled, in closed form and with no gradient step, into a low-rank update on the top two MLP layers of a frozen model such that, with the table still in the prompt, the model answers unseen questions more accurately than the unmodified model given the same prompt.

tasks.generator: tasks_v5.py, split 'confirm' (eight item groups never used in development)
tasks.confirmation_seed: to be drawn at lock time, >= 2000000
tasks.unit_of_analysis: the support table. Questions that share a table are not independent, so each table contributes one number per arm: its accuracy (correct answers divided by its question count), so 8-question and 16-question tables weigh the same. Per model, never pooled across models.

arms.base_ctx: base model, table in the prompt
arms.top2_ctx: PRIMARY: fixed adapter, table in the prompt
arms.knn_ctx: matched compute: base model plus a nearest-neighbour cache over the table's own answers (one pass)
arms.cad_ctx: greater compute: base model with context-aware decoding (two passes per token)

PRIMARY_examples_present.comparison: top2_ctx against base_ctx, per model, over the tables of both settings
PRIMARY_examples_present.test: exact or Monte Carlo two-sided sign-flip permutation test on the per-table difference in accuracy (table_level_v5.py)
PRIMARY_examples_present.pass: top2_ctx is higher and p < 0.05, on the unseen model and on at least one development model. A pass on development models only is reported as not confirmed.

matched_compute.comparison: top2_ctx against knn_ctx and against cad_ctx, same test
matched_compute.pass: reported, with this rule fixed in advance: if top2_ctx does not beat knn_ctx, the write-up says the adapter has no examples-present advantage over a nearest-neighbour cache, whatever the primary gate shows
matched_compute.cost_accounting: seconds per question for every arm from the same run; the adapter's compile time per table measured with only the fixed adapter compiled (fixed_compile_ms) and its forward-pass count; questions that share a table share one compile

guessing_control.comparison: every arm's rate of valid codes; top2_bare accuracy against 0.25 (always emitting one of four valid codes), tested per table
guessing_control.pass: one-sided sign-flip test on per-table (accuracy minus 0.25), p < 0.01, for top2_bare; valid-code rates reported for all arms
guessing_control.shuffled_label_control: REQUIRED BEFORE LOCK, NOT IMPLEMENTED: the fixed adapter compiled from the same table with the answer codes permuted across groups, run with the table present and removed. If it helps as much as the real adapter with the table present, the gain is not information from the table.

do_no_harm.pass: non-inferiority at a 5-point margin: one-sided sign-flip test on per-table (top2_ctx accuracy minus base_ctx accuracy plus 0.05) rejects 'worse by 5 points or more' at 0.05. Failing to show a difference is not a pass.

SECONDARY_prompt_removed.pass: non-inferiority at a 5-point margin: one-sided sign-flip test on per-table (top2_bare accuracy minus base_ctx accuracy plus 0.05) rejects 'worse by 5 points or more' at 0.05; time per question reported. Failing to show a difference is not a pass.
SECONDARY_prompt_removed.known_gap: REQUIRED BEFORE LOCK: a cached copy of the prompt gives base_ctx accuracy at about base_bare time, so it is the real competitor for this claim. That arm is not implemented (Doppler exposes prefix snapshots; the runner does not use them yet). The adapter's case against it is size and freed context, and the write-up must report the cache's bytes beside the adapter's.

review_20261118.by: B1 owner (bus name B), read-only reanalysis of the ten development receipts with power_v5.py; no new run

table_level_development_effects.top2_ctx_minus_base_ctx: +6.3 points over 64 tables, 35 better / 9 worse / 20 equal, sign-flip p 0.007. In the three runs made after the adapter was final (seeds 1005, 1006): +4.1 points over 20 tables, p 0.45.
table_level_development_effects.top2_ctx_minus_knn_ctx: +0.3 points over 20 tables, 5 better / 4 worse / 11 equal, p 1.0. No sign of an advantage over the nearest-neighbour cache.
table_level_development_effects.knn_ctx_minus_base_ctx: +3.8 points over 20 tables, 10 better / 2 worse / 8 equal, p 0.29.
table_level_development_effects.top2_bare_minus_base_ctx: +1.2 points over 64 tables, p 0.68; in the three later runs -6.9 points over 20 tables, p 0.16.

review_20261118.power: If the true examples-present effect equals the development 6.3 points, a sign-flip test passes about 68% of the time with 48 tables per model and about 91% with 96. The draft had 48; it is now 96 (64 few, 32 many). Development effects usually shrink, so 96 is a floor, not a guarantee.
